conditions: trace_sha256 is never recomputed over archive bytes
the archive must pass logical SHA, size and parser-counter verification before raw deletion
if the contract owner later requires the on-disk artifact to be plain JSONL, re-express as an additive v2 (CONTRACT_VERSION_REQUIRED)
rationale: logical trace identity remains sha256 of the uncompressed JSONL bytes
the archive is a lossless storage envelope: decompression is byte-identical
archive sha256, bytes and format are recorded separately
no contract row, counter, rule, endpoint, matrix, policy or statistic changes
V4 requires a 64-hex digest of the archived decision trace; the digest is over the logical trace content

representation.logical_sha256: sha256 of the uncompressed JSONL bytes (scientific identity)
